SourceText: Skipping Rope Song
text: Wimbo Wa Kuruka Kamba

SourceText:
Let’s get moving with a skipping game. 🎈
 
This energetic game builds coordination, confidence, and teamwork. 🌈
text:
Ebu tuendelee na mchezo wa kuruka. 🎈 

Mchezo huu hujenga muunganiko, kukuamini, na umoja. 🌈

SourceText:
🎈 Find a long rope or make one from tied-up tights or string. 

2️⃣ Two people turn the rope while one jumps in the middle. 

🎵 Sing a song together as they jump – do you remember one from your childhood or can you use a different song you all know? 

🏆 You can add fun moves like hopping, clapping, or even dancing while skipping. 

💛 Then switch places so everyone gets a turn.
text:
🎈 Tafuta kamba ndefu au tengeneza iliyofungwa vizuri

2️⃣ Watu wawili wazungushe kamba wakati mmoja akiruka katikati.

🎵 Imba wimbo pamoja wakiwa wanaruka - unamkumbuka mtu mmoja wakati wa watotoni au mnaweza kutumia wimbo mwingine mnaoujua wote?

🏆 Mnaweza kuongeza filamu kama matumaini, kupiga makofi, au hata kwa kucheza wakati mnatuma.

💛 Baadae mbadilishane nafasi ili kila mmoja apate kuruka.

SourceText: Round & Round
text: Zunguka & Zunguka

SourceText:
Let’s make a circle, sing, and get moving with some fun and silly moves! 🎶 

This activity builds connection, encourages coordination and balance, and sparks lots of laughter and creativity 😃
text:
Ebu tuunde duara, imba, na endelea na miondoko ya kufurahisha! 🎶 

Hii hujenga ukaribu, huhamasisha muunganiko na mlingano na muangue vicheko na kazi 😀

SourceText:
👋 Grab each other’s hands and form a circle. 

🎵 Walk round and round while you sing a song you know - it could be one from your childhood like “Ring-a-Rosy” or “Sawa Sonke”, or a favourite your child loves. 

🎉 As you go round, add some silly moves to make it even more fun. Try hopping on one leg, see if you can put your leg over the next person’s arm, or gently fall to the ground when the song finishes. 

🔄 Take turns choosing the next move or song!
text:
👋 Shikaneni mikono na uunde mduara.

🎵 Tembea huku na huku, huku ukiimba wimbo unaojua - unaweza kuwa wimbo wa utotoni mwako kama vile “Ring-a-Rosy” au “Sawa Sonke”, au wimbo unaopenda mtoto wako.

Unapozunguka, ongeza hatua za kipuuzi ili kuifanya iwe ya kufurahisha zaidi. Jaribu kuruka juu ya mguu mmoja, angalia ikiwa unaweza kuweka mguu wako juu ya mkono wa mtu mwingine, au kuanguka chini kwa upole wakati wimbo unakamilika.
Pokezaneni kuchagua hoja au wimbo unaofuata!

SourceText: Can You Catch It?
text: Unaweza Kukikamata?

SourceText:
Let’s see if you can follow instructions while catching a ball! ⚽ 

This activity is a great way to improve coordination, concentration, and quick thinking - all while having fun! 💡
text:
Embu tuone kama unaweza kufuata maelekezo wakati wa kukamata mpira! ⚽

Shughuli hii ni njia nzuri ya kuboresha uratibu, umakini, na kufikiri kwa haraka – vyote huku ukifurahia! 💡

SourceText:
✅ Start by standing about three metres apart and gently throw a ball at each other. After a few easy throws, it’s time to introduce the rules!

1️⃣ When the thrower shouts ‘one’, the catcher has to catch the ball with their right hand and put their left foot out. 

2️⃣ If the thrower shouts ‘two’, the catcher catches with their left hand and puts their right foot out.

⭐ Once you’re confident, add some extra numbers and rules! 

⏰ For the game to work, make sure the number is called before you throw the ball, so the catcher has time to react!
text:
✅ Anza kwa kusimama umbali wa takribani mita tatu kisha mtupiane mpira taratibu. Baada ya kutupiana mara chache kwa urahisi, sasa ni wakati wa kuanzisha sheria!

1️⃣ Wakati mtupaji akisema ‘moja’, mkamataji lazima akamate mpira kwa mkono wa kulia na aweke mguu wa kushoto mbele.

2️⃣ Iwapo mtupaji atasema ‘mbili’, mkamataji anakamata mpira kwa mkono wa kushoto na kuweka mguu wa kulia mbele.

⭐ Ukishajizoea vizuri, ongeza namba zaidi na sheria nyingine za kucheza!

⏰ Ili mchezo uende vizuri, hakikisha namba inatolewa kabla ya kutupa mpira, ili mkamataji awe na muda wa kujibu!

SourceText: 🚩 You can adjust the rules to make it perfect for every age.
text: 🚩 Unaweza kurekebisha sheria ili kuifanya iwe kamili kwa kila umri.

SourceText: Adapted from Learning Through Play: https://learningthroughplay.com/let-s-play/can-you-catch-it
text: Imechukuliwa Kutoka Kwa Kujifunza Kupitia Kucheza: https://learningthroughplay.com/let-s-play/can-you-catch-it

SourceText: Unseen Guesses
text: Makisio Yasiyoonekana

SourceText:
You can do this activity when you are together with at least three people in total. 3️⃣  

This game is not only fun but also helps children develop strong communication skills and teaches them how to work together to achieve a goal. 💚
text:
Unaweza kufanya shughuli hii mkiwa pamoja walau watu watatu. 3️⃣

Mchezo huu sio wa kufurahisha tu bali pia huwasaidia watoto kukuza ujuzi thabiti wa mawasiliano na kuwafundisha jinsi ya kufanya kazi pamoja ili kufikia lengo. 💚

SourceText:
👀 Ask your child and another child/adult to sit next to each other. Blindfold both using a scarf or hat. 

🚗 Give your child an object and ask them to feel it and describe it, without saying the name of the object!

🎁 The other person’s job is to figure out what the object is based on the description. 

✅ The “guesser” can ask questions, but the “speaker” can only answer with "yes" or "no".

🔄 After each round, swap roles and play again, giving everyone a chance to be the “speaker” and “guesser” and the one to provides the object.
text:
👀 Uliza mtoto wako na mtoto mwingine/mtu mzima kukaa karibu karibu. Wafunge macho wote kwa kutumia skafu au kofia.

🚗 Mpe mtoto wako kitu na umwombe akishike na akielezee, bila kutaja jina la kitu hicho!

🎁 Kazi ya mtu mwingine ni kubaini ni kitu gani kulingana na maelezo.


✅ "Mtabiri" anaweza kuuliza maswali, lakini "mzungumzaji" anaweza tu kujibu kwa "ndiyo" au "hapana".

🔄 Baada ya kila mzunguko, badilishana majukumu na ucheze tena, ukimpa kila mtu nafasi ya kuwa "mzungumzaji" na "mtabiri" na yule wa kutoa kitu.

SourceText: Adapted from Learning Through Play: https://learningthroughplay.com/let-s-play/unseen-guesses
text: Imechukuliwa kutoka Kujifunza Kupitia Kucheza: https://learningthroughplay.com/let-s-play/unseen-guesses

SourceText: A Friendly Chat
text: Mazungumzo ya Kirafiki

SourceText:
Want to connect with your teen? Start by talking about what they care about! 😃

These small chats can lead to stronger connections and bigger conversations down the road.👂❤️
text:
Je unahitaji kuwa karibu na kijana wako? Anza kwa kuongelea kuhusu vitu wanavyovijari! 😀

Maongezi haya madogo madogo yanaweza kupelekea ukaribu mkubwa na maongezi makubwa hapo mbeleni.👂♥️

SourceText: ⚽ An easy way to start talking to your teen is to ask them about something they are interested in. For example, you could talk about sports, books, movies, friends, music, celebrities, or school.
text: ⚽ Njia rahisi ya kuanza kuongea na kijana wako ni kuwauliza kuhusu vitu wanavyopendelea. Kwa mfano, mnaweza kuongea kuhusu mchezo, vitabu, filamu, muziki, watu maarufu, au shule.

SourceText: 👂 You may not find everything your teen shares to be interesting, but it’s important to show enthusiasm and an eagerness to learn.
text: 👂 Unaweza usione kila kitu anachokushirikisha kijana wako kuwa cha kuvutia, lakini ni muhimu kuonesha umeguswa na unatamani kujifunza.

SourceText: Reflect on the Positive
text: Tafakari juu ya Mazuri

SourceText:
Looking for a simple way to boost your mood and connect as a family? Try this quick daily check-in! 🌈

Sharing positive moments - big or small - helps everyone feel more grateful and supported.
text:
Je unatafuta njia rahisi ya kuamsha morali yenu na kuwa karibu kama familia? Jaribu hii yakumjulia hali kila mtu kila siku! 🌈 
Kushirikishana nyakati chanya - kubwa au ndogo - husaidia kila mmoja kujihisi wa muhimu na anapata msaada.

SourceText:
💡 Together, take a minute to think about all the things you did today. 

☀️ Take turns sharing one positive or fun thing that happened. This could be something small, like feeling good because you cleaned the house, or something big, like spending time with family and friends. 

⏰ Try doing this every day - even more on the days it feels like you have not done anything special.
text:
💡 Kwa pamoja, tumia dakika moja kufikiria vitu vyote mlivyofanya Leo.

☀️ Shirikishaneni kitu kimoja chanya au cha kufurahisha kilichotokea. Inaweza kuwa kitu kidogo, kama vile kujisikia vizuri kwa sababu umesafisha nyumba, au kitu kikunwa, kama kutumia muda wa pamoja na familia na marafiki.

⏰ Jaribu kufanya hivi kila siku - hasa kwa siku unazohisi kama hujafanya kitu muhimu.

SourceText: Dance Moves
text: Miondoko ya Kucheza

SourceText: Let's get moving! 👋 Dancing is a great way to exercise, have fun, and bond with your teen at the same time!  🎵
text: Ebu tuendelee! 👋 Kucheza mziki ni njia nzuri ya kufanya mazoezi, kufurahia, na wakati huo huo kuwa karibu na kijana! 🎵

SourceText:
This game can be played in pairs or a group with everyone taking turns being the leader:

📱 Let your teen choose a song they like and create a set of dance moves.
👀 First person does a dance move and everyone else copies it.
☀️ Don’t worry about perfecting the dance moves, it’s all about having fun together!
💡 If you want to, you can perform your dance for the household!
text:
Mchezo huu unaweza kuchezwa wawili wawili au kikundi huku kila mmoja akichukua zamu kuwa kiongozi:

📱 Ruhusu kijana wako achague wimbo anaoupenda na atengeneze aina mbali mbali ya miondoko ya dansi.
👀 Mtu wa kwanza anacheza densi na kila mtu anaigilizia.
☀️ Usijali kuhusu kuboresha miondoko ya dansi, ni kuhusu kufurahiya pamoja!
💡 Ukitaka, unaweza kuigiza dansi yako kwa ajili ya kaya!

SourceText: Check-in Chat
text: Angalia kwenye Mazungumzo

SourceText: Actively checking in on one another helps to keep relationships healthy! ⭐
text: Kujuliana hali mara kwa mara husaidia kudumisha uhusiano mzuri! ⭐

SourceText:
Ask each other questions: 
👂🏾 “What made you happy today?” 
💛 “What was difficult today?”  
🫶🏾 “How can I help you?”
text:
Ulizaneni maswali: 
👂🏾 "Ni nini kilikufurahisha leo?" 
💛 "Ni nini kilikuwa kigumu leo?"  
🫶🏾 "Nikusaidieje?"

SourceText:
Go easy on yourself if your teen does not want to share their problems with you. 💙 

Often, teens are afraid to share as they are scared they will get in trouble. Getting upset with them won’t help - keep showing you love them and give them time! 🌷
text:
Kuwa na amani kama kijana wako hataki kukushirikisha matatizo yake. 💙 

Mara nyingi, vijana wanaogopa kusema kwa sababu wanahisi wataingia kwenya matatizo. Kuwakasirikia hakutasaidia - endelea kuwaonyesha unawapenda na uwape muda! 🌷

SourceText: Express Yourself
text: Jielezee

SourceText:
This playful dance game is a great way to get moving and boost everyone’s mood! 💃🕺

It encourages creativity, memory, and teamwork - all while having fun as a family. 🎶
text:
Huu mchezo wakucheza ni namna nzuri yakufanya kila mtu ajumuike na unainua hali ya kila mtu! 💃🕺

Inahamasisha ubunifu, kumbukumbu, na kufanya kazi kwa pamoja - wakati wote tukiwa tunafurahia kama familia. 🎶

SourceText:
🌈 This game can be played in pairs or as a group - stand facing each other or in a circle.
🎵 Together, choose a fun and upbeat song to play and a person to start the game by creating one dance move.
👀 The person to their right must copy that dance move and add their own move to it.
✨ Go around the circle, each person adding their own dance move to the full song.
🔄 The first one who forgets someone's dance moves or does it in the wrong order chooses the next song and starts the game again.
🎉 Try new dance moves with this game and have fun!
text:
🌈 Mchezo huu unaweza kuchezwa wawili wawili au kama kikundi - simameni mkitazamana au kwenye mduara.
🎵 Kwa pamoja, chagua wimbo wa kufurahisha na wa kusisimua wa kucheza na mtu wa kuanzisha mchezo kwa kuunda harakati moja ya dansi.
👀 Mtu aliye upande wake wa kulia lazima aigize hiyo ngoma na aongeze mwendo wake kwake.
✨ Zunguka kwenye mduara, kila mtu akiongeza dansi yake kwa wimbo kamili.
🔄 Wa kwanza anayesahau ngoma ya mtu anasonga au anaifanya kwa mpangilio mbaya anachagua wimbo unaofuata na kuanza mchezo tena.
🎉 Jaribu miondoko mipya ya ngoma na mchezo huu na ufurahie!

SourceText: Weekly Goal Setting
text: Kupangilia Malengo ya Wiki

SourceText:
Setting goals together is a great way to build confidence and stay motivated! ⭐

Weekly goals are small steps that help you and your teen grow - one week at a time. 🎉
text:
Kuweka malengo pamoja ni njia nzuri ya kujenga kujiamini na kuendelea kuhamasishwa! ⭐

Malengo ya kila wiki ni hatua ndogo zinazokusaidia wewe na kijana wako kukua - wiki moja baada ya nyingine. 🎉

SourceText:
1. ⭐ At the start of the week, help your teen set one specific and achievable goal.
2. 🤝 Share your own goal too - support each other throughout the week.
3. 🎉 Praise your teen’s effort and celebrate their progress.
4. 💬 If they don’t reach their goal, talk about what happened and how to try again next time.
text:
1. ⭐ Mwanzoni mwa juma, msaidie kijana wako kuweka lengo moja mahususi na linaloweza kufikiwa.
2. 🤝 Shiriki lengo lako pia - kusaidiana wiki nzima.
3. 🎉 Sifu juhudi za kijana wako na ufurahie maendeleo yao.
4. 💬 Ikiwa hawatafikia lengo lao, zungumza kuhusu kilichotokea na jinsi ya kujaribu tena wakati ujao.

SourceText: 🔁 Make this a weekly habit to build confidence and success step by step!
text: 🔁 Fanya hili kuwa tabia ya kila wiki ili kujenga ujasiri na mafanikio hatua kwa hatua!

SourceText: Role play
text: Maigizo

SourceText:
Let’s start acting! ⭐

Role-playing is when you pretend to be someone in a certain situation, and act out how you think things will go. 

This is a fun way to help your teen understand how others might act or feel, and for you to learn more about how your teen thinks and feels. ✨
text:
Tuanze kuigiza! ⭐

Igizo ni pale ambapo unajifanya kuwa mtu katika hali fulani na kuigiza namna unafikiri vitu vitakavyoenda. 

Hii ni njia ya furaha ya kumsaidia kijana wako aelewe jinsi wengine watafanya au kujisikia na kwa ajili yako kujifunza zaidi kuhusu namna kijana wako anavofikiria na kujisikia. ✨

SourceText:
1. 😊 Ask your teen if they’d like to try a fun “role-playing” game with you.
2. 🎭 Let them choose a situation to act out - it could be something from school or even social media. For example, playing a teacher and student, or a teen being offered a drink at a party.
3. 🎬 Let your teen decide who plays each role, and act it out together!
4. 💬 After the role-play, talk about what you both learned. Ask questions like, “How did that feel?” or “What did you notice about the situation?” This helps your teen understand different perspectives and emotions.
text:
1. 😊 Muulize kijana wako kama angependa kujaribu nawe mchezo wa kufurahisha wa "kuigiza-igiza".
2. 🎭 Waache wachague hali ya kuigiza - inaweza kuwa kitu kutoka shuleni au hata mitandao ya kijamii. Kwa mfano, kucheza mwalimu na mwanafunzi, au kijana anayepewa kinywaji kwenye sherehe.
3. 🎬 Acha kijana wako aamue ni nani atakayecheza kila jukumu, na muigize pamoja!
4. 💬 Baada ya igizo, zungumza kuhusu mlichojifunza nyote wawili. Uliza maswali kama, "vipi umeionaje hiyo?" au “Umeona nini kuhusu hali hiyo?” Hii humsaidia kijana wako kuelewa mitazamo na hisia tofauti.

SourceText: Make Housework Fun
text: Fanya kazi za nyumbani ziwe za kufurahisha

SourceText:
Turn your chores into games! 🏆 

Making housework fun is a good way to teach your teen to be responsible and to rely on themselves. ☀️
text:
Badilisha shughuli zako za nyumbani kuwa michezo! 🏆 

Kufanya kazi za nyumbani kuwa za kufurahisha ni njia nzuri ya kumfundisha kijana wako kuwajibika na kujitegemea. ☀️

SourceText:
📝 Together, make a list of all the chores that must be done in your home. 

💡 Make sure the tasks are fair and things your teen can do. For example, washing up, sweeping, mopping, making the beds, and laundry.

🔄 Each week, let a different person in the family choose a chore first.

🎵 Play some music or turn on the radio. Music is a great way to make a boring task fun!

✅ Tick off the tasks when they are done so you can see your progress as a family. 
📺 You could offer small rewards as motivation to complete activities. For example, you could let your teen watch more TV or have something sweet if they do their chores in a fair amount of time.
text:
📝 Kwa pamoja, tengeneza orodha ya kazi zote zinazopaswa kufanywa nyumbani kwako. 

💡 Hakikisha kuwa kazi ni za haki na mambo ambayo kijana wako anaweza kufanya. Kwa mfano, kuosha, kufagia, kukokota, kutandika vitanda, na kufulia.

🔄 Kila juma, acha mtu tofauti katika familia achague kazi ya nyumbani kwanza.

🎵 Cheza muziki au washa redio. Muziki ni njia nzuri ya kufanya kazi inayochosha iwe ya kufurahisha!

✅ Weka alama kwenye kazi zinapokamilika ili muweze kuona maendeleo yenu kama familia. 
📺 Unaweza kutoa zawadi ndogo kama motisha ya kukamilisha shughuli. Kwa mfano, unaweza kumruhusu kijana wako kutazama TV zaidi au kuwa na kitu kitamu ikiwa anafanya kazi zake za nyumbani kwa wakati unaofaa.

SourceText: ❓ If your child does not complete a chore, ask them why, and come up with a fair consequence together.
text: ❓ Ikiwa mtoto wako hatokamilisha kazi fulani, waulize ni kwa nini, na mje na

SourceText: Walking Together
text: Kutembea Pamoja

SourceText: Walking together is a fun, healthy way to connect and help your teen learn more about their community. 🚶‍♂️🌿
text: Kutembea pamoja ni njia ya kufurahisha, yenye afya ya kuunganishwa na kumsaidia kijana wako kujifunza zaidi kuhusu jumuiya yake. 🚶‍♂️🌿

SourceText:
🗓️ Plan together: Choose a time and place to walk - a park, market, or anywhere nearby. If you’re going out, invite your teen to join!

👀 Explore: Encourage your teen to ask questions about what they see - people, nature, or buildings.

💬 Share: Tell them fun facts or memories about the area, like who lives nearby or how things looked before.
text:
🗓️ Panga pamoja: Chagua wakati na mahali pa kutembea - bustanini, sokoni, au mahali popote karibu nawe. Ikiwa utatoka, mwalike kijana wako ajiunge!

👀 Gundua: Mhimize kijana wako aulize maswali kuhusu kile anachokiona - watu, asili au majengo.

💬 Shirikisha: Waambie ukweli au kumbukumbu za kufurahisha kuhusu eneo hilo, kama vile ni nani anayeishi karibu au jinsi mambo yalivyokuwa hapo awali.

SourceText: Gardening
text: Shughuli za bustani

SourceText: Gardening is a fun way to bond with your teen while teaching them how to grow food and care for nature. 🌿
text: Kutunza bustani ni njia ya kufurahisha ya kuwasiliana na kijana wako huku ukimfundisha jinsi ya kupanda chakula na kutunza asili. 🌿

SourceText:
🌿 Choose plants: Let your teen pick veggies or herbs to grow - they’ll love being involved and can help cook them later!

🪴 Get creative: No garden? No problem! Use old buckets, cans, or bottles as plant pots.

🎉 Plant together: Turn planting into a fun “planting party” - take turns putting seeds in the soil.

💧 Care routine: Make a watering schedule and let your teen take charge of their plants.

📏 Track growth: Each week, have your teen note the changes and see how much the plants have grown!
text:
🌿 Chagua mimea: Mruhusu kijana wako achume mboga au mitishamba ili kukua - atapenda kuhusika na anaweza kusaidia kupika baadaye!

🪴 Kuwa mbunifu: Je, huna bustani? Hakuna tatizo! Tumia ndoo kuukuu, mikebe, au chupa kama vyungu vya kupanda.

🎉 Panda pamoja: Badili upandaji kuwa "sherehe ya upandaji" ya kufurahisha - badilishane kupanda mbegu kwenye udongo.

💧 Utaratibu wa utunzaji: Tengeneza ratiba ya kumwagilia maji na umruhusu kijana wako asimamie mimea yake.

📏 Fuatilia ukuaji: Kila wiki, mwambie kijana wako atambue mabadiliko na uone mimea imekua kiasi gani!

SourceText: Charades
text: Mchezo wa mafumbo

SourceText: Charades is an easy, fun game that will teach your teen to think quickly, work together and be bold. 🎭
text: Mchezo wa mafumbo ni rahisi, wa kufurahisha utamsaidia kijana wako kufikiri kwa haraka, kufanya kazi kwa pamoja na kuwa jasiri. 🎭

SourceText:
1. 🤫 One person quietly thinks of a word but doesn’t say it out loud to anyone.

2. 🎭 That person then acts out the word using only actions - no speaking, sounds, or pointing to objects.

3. 🧹 Others try to guess what the word is! You can choose fun everyday actions like sweeping, eating, playing football, or brushing teeth.

4. ✅ When someone guesses correctly, it becomes their turn to think of a new word and act it out. Keep taking turns and enjoy the game!
text:
1. 🤫 Mtu mmoja anafikiria neno kimya kimya lakini hasemi kwa sauti kwa mtu yeyote.

2. 🎭 Mtu huyo huigiza neno kwa kutumia vitendo pekee - hakuna kuzungumza, sauti, au kuashiria vitu.

3. 🧹 Wengine hujaribu kukisia neno ni nini! Unaweza kuchagua vitendo vya kufurahisha vya kila siku kama vile kufagia, kula, kucheza mpira wa miguu au kupiga mswaki.

4. ✅ Mtu anapokisia kwa usahihi, inakuwa zamu yake kufikiria neno jipya na kuigiza. Endelea kuchukua zamu na ufurahie mchezo!

SourceText:
* Make sure everyone gets a turn to act out words or phrases.  
* Remember to praise your teen for trying. 
* If your teen is struggling to guess, give them hints on what it could be.
* If the game is too easy, try more difficult words. 
* Remember to have fun and support each other!
text:
* Hakikisha kila mmoja anapata nafasi ya kuigiza neno au misemo.
* Kumbuka kumpongeza kijana wako kwa kujaribu.
* Kama kijana wako anapata changamoto, mpatie vidokezo kuhusu nini inaweza kuwa.
* Kama mchezo ni rahisi sana, jaribu maneno au misemo migumu.
* Kumbuka kufurahia na msaidiane kwa pamoja katika mchezo wote!

SourceText: Cooking
text: Kupika

SourceText: Cooking with your teen is a fun way to spend time together while teaching helpful life skills. 🍳👨‍🍳
text: Kupika na kijana wako ni njia ya kufurahisha ya kutumia wakati wa pamoja huku ukimfundisha ujuzi muhimu wa maisha. 🍳👨‍🍳

SourceText:
🗓️ Pick a time and day to cook together - planning ahead makes it easier.
🥬 Show your teen the recipe and ingredients, and let them help with measuring.
🍲 Give them a task like fetching water, chopping, or stirring.
🍽️ Eat together with the family and let your teen feel proud for helping make the meal!
text:
🗓️ Chagua wakati na siku ya kupika pamoja - kupanga mapema hurahisisha.
🥬 Muoneshe kijana wako mapishi na viungo, na uwaruhusu wakusaidie kupima.
🍲 Wape kazi kama vile kuchota maji, kukatakata au kukoroga.
🍽️ Kula pamoja na familia na umruhusu kijana wako ajisikie fahari kwa kusaidia kuandaa mlo huo!

SourceText:
- Let your teen help choose the recipe or ingredients.
- Involve them in different things, like washing, measuring, cutting, and mixing.
- Praise their effort, even if the food isn’t perfect.
text:
- Acha kijana wako akusaidie kuchagua mapishi au viungo.
- Washirikishe katika mambo mbalimbali, kama kuosha, kupima, kukata na kuchanganya.
- Sifu juhudi zao, hata kama chakula si kamili.

SourceText: Storytelling
text: Kusimulia hadithi

SourceText: Storytelling is a wonderful way to help your teen feel more connected with you, as well as with their family, history and culture. 💬✨
text: Kusimulia hadithi ni njia nzuri ya kumsaidia kijana wako kuhisi kuwa ameunganishwa zaidi na wewe, pamoja na familia, historia na utamaduni wao. 💬✨

SourceText:
📅 Choose a time and place where you and your teen can talk comfortably - like after dinner, before bed, or during a walk.

🗣️ Begin by sharing a story of your own. It might be something from today, a childhood memory, or a special moment.

❓ When you’re done, invite your teen to ask questions or share a story of their own.

👂 Listen with interest, ask questions, and show you care about what they say.

💡 If they’re unsure, ask something like “What’s your favourite childhood memory?” or “What’s a family tradition you enjoy?” They can even make up a story just for fun!
text:
📅 Chagua wakati na mahali ambapo wewe na kijana wako mnaweza kuzungumza kwa raha - kama vile baada ya chakula cha jioni, kabla ya kulala, au wakati wa matembezi.

🗣️ Anza kwa kutoa hadithi yako wewe mwenyewe. Inaweza kuwa kitu kilicho tokea leo, kumbukumbu ya utotoni, au wakati maalum.

❓ Ukimaliza, mualike kijana wako kuuliza maswali au kukuambia hadithi yake mwenyewe.

👂 Sikiliza kwa kupendezwa, uliza maswali, na uonyeshe unajali kuhusu wanachosema.

💡 Ikiwa hawana uhakika, waulize kitu kama "Ni kumbukumbu gani unazopenda za utotoni?" au “Ni desturi gani ya familia unayofurahia?” Wanaweza hata kutengeneza hadithi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha tu!

SourceText: - Create a safe space for your teen to share their stories. They will share more with you if they feel like you won’t be upset with them.
text: - Andaa nafasi salama kwa kijana wako kuelezea hadithi zao. Watashiriki nawe zaidi ikiwa wanahisi kama hutakerwa nao.

SourceText: Music and Dance
text: Muziki na Kucheza

SourceText: Dancing is a fun way to get exercise, and a great way to learn about your teen’s interests. 🎶
text: Kucheza mziki ni njia ya kufurahisha ya kufanya mazoezi, na njia nzuri ya kujifunza kuhusu mambo yanayomvutia kijana wako. 🎶

SourceText:
🎶 Ask your teen what music they like - show real interest by asking where they heard it and what they enjoy about it.

💃 Teach each other your favourite dance moves or learn new ones together.

🎉 Once you’ve got some moves down, practise them together and just have fun!
text:
🎶 Muulize kijana wako ni muziki gani wanaopenda. Onyesha shauku ya kweli kwa kuuliza maswali zaidi kama mahali walipoisikia na kile wanachopenda kuihusu.

💃Fundishaneni mitindo ya miziki mnayoipenda au jifunzeni mpya pamoja.

🎉 Mkisha jifunza miondoko ya mziki mpya, ifanyieni mazoezi pamoja. Kumbuka kufurahia!

SourceText:
- Let your teen show you their music and dance moves.
- Don't take it too seriously, be silly and have fun together.
text:
- Acha kijana wako akuonyeshe muziki na miondoko yake yakucheza.
- Usichukulie kwa uzito sana, puuzia na mufurahie pamoja.

SourceText: Dream Travel
text: Ndoto ya Safari

SourceText: Exploring the world through imagination is a fun way to bond and spark your teen’s curiosity - no suitcase needed! ✈️
text: Kuchunguza ulimwengu kupitia mawaazo ni njia ya kufurahisha ya kua karibu na kuamsha udadisi wa kijana wako - hautoitaji begi! ✈️

SourceText:
🌍 Ask your teen these questions: *Where would you want to travel to? How long would you be away? What would you pack? What would you do on your trip? What would you see?*

🗺️ Look at a map or draw one together.

📚 Pick a country your teen hasn’t heard of and explore fun facts about it together!
text:
🌍 Muulize kijana wako maswali haya: *Ungependa kusafiri kwenda wapi? Je, ungeondoka kwa muda gani? Ungebeba nini? Ungefanya nini kwenye safari yako? Ungeona nini?*

🗺️ Angalia ramani au choreni moja pamoja.

📚 Chagua nchi ambayo kijana wako hajaisikia na mchunguze ukweli wa kufurahisha kuihusu pamoja!

SourceText: Famous Party
text: Chama Maarufu

SourceText: Planning a dream party is a fun and creative way to spark conversation with your teen - and learn more about who inspires them! 🌟
text: Kupangilia sherehe ya ndoto yako ni njia ya kufurahisha na ya ubunifu ya kuibua mazungumzo na kijana wako - na ujifunze zaidi kuhusu anayewatia moyo! 🌟

SourceText:
🎉 You and your teen can plan a dream guestlist of famous people to invite to your party!

📜 Each of you chooses five guests - they can be from the past or present.

🤔 Who would you invite? And do you think your guests would get along at the party?
text:
🎉 Wewe na kijana wako mnaweza kupanga orodha ya ndoto yanu ya wageni maarufu ili kuwaalika kwenye sherehe yako!

📜 Kila mmoja wenu anachagua wageni watano - wanaweza kuwa wa zamani au wa sasa.

🤔 Je, ungemwalika nani? Na unafikiri wageni wako wataelewana kwenye karamu?

SourceText: Two Truths, One Lie
text: Ukweli mara Mbili, Uongo Mara moja

SourceText: Want a fun way to laugh and learn more about each other? Try this quick game of “Two Truths and a Lie” with your teen! 🤗
text: Unataka njia ya kufurahisha ya kucheka na kujifunza zaidi kuhusu kila mmoja? Jaribu mchezo huu wa haraka wa "Ukweli Mbili na Uongo" pamoja na kijana wako! 🤗

SourceText:
🧠 Think of three statements about yourself - two true and one that’s a lie.
- It can help to think about dreams, school, likes or dislikes. For example: *I hate bananas, my favourite subject is science, and I really wish I could sing.*

🗣️ Share them with your teen and ask them to guess which one is the lie.

😲 Did they guess right? Were they surprised?

🔁 Now let your teen try! Did you learn something new about each other?
text:
🧠 Fikiria kauli tatu kuhusu wewe. Mbili ni lazima ziwe za kweli na moja iwe ya uongo.
- Inaweza kusaidia kufikiria ndoto zako, shule, mambo unayopenda au usiyopenda. Kwa mfano: *Sipendi ndizi, somo ninalolipenda zaidi ni sayansi, na ninatamani sana ningejua kuimba.*

🗣️ Ziseme kwa kijana wako na mwambie akisie kauli ipi ni ya uongo.

😲 Je, wamekisia kwa usahihi? Je, walikushangaza?

🔁 Sasa mwambie na yeye afanye hivyohivyo. Je, mmejifunza jambo jipya kuhusu kila mmoja wenu?

SourceText: Superpower
text: Nguvu ya kimaajabu

SourceText: Imagining superpowers is a fun way to spark creativity, play and connection with your teen!🦸‍♀️
text: Kufikiria kuhusu nguvu ya kimaajabu ni njia ya kufurahisha ya kuibua ubunifu, kucheza na kuunganishwa na kijana wako!🦸‍♀️

SourceText:
💥 Think of a superpower - like travelling through time, or reading minds.

❓ Ask your teen, “If you had the superpower to […], how would you use it?”

🦸 Encourage them to name their superhero and act it out!

🔁 Let your teen choose a superpower for you too.

🎭 Don’t forget to act out your superpower and have fun together!
text:
💥 Fikiria nguvu ya kimaajabu - kama vile kuwa na uwezo wa kusafiri kurudi nyuma ya muda au mble ya muda, au kusoma watu wanachowaza.

❓ Muulize kijana wako, “Ikiwa ungekuwa na nguvu za kimaajabu […], ungezitumiaje?”

🦸 Wahimize wamtaje shujaa wao na kuigiza!

🔁 Acha kijana wako akuchagulie nguvu ya kimaajabu pia.

🎭 Usisahau kuigiza uwezo wako mkuu na kufurahia pamoja!

SourceText: The Interrupter
text: Mdakizi

SourceText: This fun and silly storytelling game is a great way to boost creativity and laughter with your teen! 💥
text: Mchezo huu wa kufurahisha na wa kusimulia hadithi ni njia nzuri ya kuongeza ubunifu na kicheko na kijana wako! 💥

SourceText:
📚 Choose a storyteller to start making up a story.

🗣️ Listeners can jump in anytime with any word, at any time.

🔄 The storyteller must include that word in their story - no matter how silly!

🎉 When the story ends, switch roles and let someone else be the storyteller!
text:
📚 Chagua msimulizi wa hadithi ili kuanza kutunga hadithi.

🗣️ Wasikilizaji wanaweza kutoa neno wakati wowote kwa mda wowote.

🔄 Msimulizi wa hadithi lazima ajumuishe neno hilo katika hadithi yao - haijalishi ni la kipuuzi kwa kiasi gani!

🎉 Hadithi inapoisha, badilishaneni majukumu na umruhusu mtu mwingine awe msimulizi wa hadithi!

SourceText: Get Active
text: Kuwa Mchangamfu

SourceText: Exercise is a great way to spend time together and it is so good for your health. Find a sport or exercise that both you and your teen want to do and try it out together! 🌱
text: Mazoezi ni njia nzuri ya kutumia wakati wa pamoja na ni mazuri sana kwa afya yako. Tafuta mchezo au mazoezi ambayo wewe na kijana wako mnataka kufanya na mjaribu pamoja! 🌱

SourceText:
⏰ Even walking for 10 minutes a day is good for you. 

⚽ Together you can walk, run, play soccer, swim, dance, or do any other sport..

🏆 Together, think of ways to make it even more fun. Can you jog to a certain point? Take turns being the coach? Can there be a small, free reward, like getting to decide the next activity?
text:
⏰ Hata kutembea kwa dakika 10 kwa siku ni vizuri kwako. 

⚽ Pamoja mnaweza kutembea, kukimbia, kucheza soka, kuogelea, kucheza au kufanya mchezo mwingine wowote..

🏆 Pamoja, fikiria njia za kuifanya iwe ya kufurahisha zaidi. Je, unaweza kukimbia hadi hatua fulani? Kubadilishana kuwa kocha? Je, kunaweza kuwa na zawadi ndogo, isiyolipishwa, kama kupata uamuzi wa shughuli inayofuata?

SourceText: This is Who I Am
text: Huyu ndiye Mimi

SourceText: Self-esteem is the way you value yourself, either in a positive or negative way. Helping your teen to have high self-esteem is a recipe for success! 🏆
text: Kujithamini ni jinsi unavyojithamini, iwe kwa njia nzuri au mbaya. Kumsaidia kijana wako kujistahi sana ni kichocheo cha mafanikio! 🏆

SourceText:
⭐Share with your teen 3 things you like about yourself!

3️⃣ Ask your teen to tell you 3 things they like about themselves. 
For example: I am great at treating others kindly. I am great at styling my hair. I am great at football. ⚽
text:
⭐ Mshirikishe kijana wako mambo 3 unayopenda kukuhusu wewe!

3️⃣ Muulize kijana wako akuambie mambo 3 anayopenda kuhusu yeye. 
Kwa mfano: Mimi ni hodari katika kuwatendea wengine wema. Mimi ni hodari katika kutengeneza nywele zangu. Mimi ni mzuri kwenye soka. ⚽

SourceText: 📝 If your teen does not feel comfortable sharing these, ask them to write them down.
text: 📝 Ikiwa kijana wako hajisikii vizuri kushiriki haya, mwambie ayaandike.

SourceText: Traffic Lights
text: Taa za Trafiki

SourceText: A group activity is a great way to bond with others! 💛
text: Shughuli ya kikundi ni njia nzuri ya kushikamana na wengine! 💛

SourceText:
💡 Choose one person to turn and face a wall. This will be the traffic officer. 

🏁 Everyone else will begin the game at the other side of the room, or if you are outside, at a starting line. Set a long distance between the traffic officer and the players. 

💚 The game begins when the officer shouts “Green”, and everyone can start moving towards the traffic officer at any speed they choose. 

🔴 The officer can shout “Red!” at any time, without looking behind them. When they shout this, everyone must stop and freeze! 

⏸ The officer turns around to see if everyone is frozen. If they see anyone moving, they have to send them back to the start line.

🏆 The winner is the first person to get to the officer without being sent back to the start.

👑 The winner then becomes the traffic officer and you can play another round!
text:
💡 Chagua mtu mmoja wa kugeuka na kuangaliaa ukuta. Huyu atakuwa afisa wa trafiki. 

🏁 Kila mtu mwingine ataanza mchezo upande mwingine wa chumba, au ikiwa uko nje, kwenye mstari wa kuanzia. Weka umbali mrefu kati ya afisa wa trafiki na wachezaji. 

💚 Mchezo huanza wakati afisa anapopiga kelele “Kijani”, na kila mtu anaweza kuanza kumsogelea afisa wa trafiki kwa kasi yoyote anayochagua. 

🔴 Afisa anaweza kupiga kelele "Nyekundu!" wakati wowote, bila kuangalia nyuma yao. Wanapopiga kelele hivi, kila mtu lazima asimame na kuganda! 

⏸ Afisa anageuka ili kuona kama kila mtu ameganda. Iwapo wataona mtu yeyote anasonga, wanapaswa kumrudisha kwenye mstari wa kuanzia.

🏆 Mshindi ndiye mtu wa kwanza kufika kwa afisa bila kurudishwa mwanzo.

👑 Mshindi basi anakuwa afisa wa trafiki na unaweza kucheza raundi nyingine!

SourceText: Think Big, Think Small
text: Fikiri Sana, Fikiri Kidogo

SourceText: Working towards big goals can be hard! Here is a way you can help your teen set new goals for the things they want to achieve. 👑
text: Kufanya kazi kwa malengo makubwa inaweza kuwa ngumu! Hapa kuna njia unayoweza kumsaidia kijana wako kuweka malengo mapya kwa mambo anayotaka kufikia. 👑

SourceText:
👑 Ask your teen to come up with three things that they are good at, and discuss what they did to become so good at them. For example: keeping their room neat, helping your family with housework, or playing a sport.

🏆 Next, ask your teen what they wish they were good at. 

🔑 Remind them that it took work and practice to become good at the skills they have. They will have to do the same for any new goal.

⏰ Help your teen break down their goal and set up smaller goals they need to achieve to reach their greater goal.
text:
👑 Muulize kijana wako aeleze mambo matatu anayoyafanya vizuri, kisha mjadili jinsi alivyofanikisha kuwa mzuri katika mambo hayo. Kwa mfano: kuweka chumba chake safi, kusaidia familia kwenye kazi za nyumbani, au kucheza michezo.

🏆 Kisha, muulize kijana wako ni kitu gani angependa kukifanya vizuri.

🔑 Wakumbushe kwamba ili kufanikisha ujuzi walio nao, inahitaji kazi na mazoezi. Watahitaji kufanya vivyo hivyo ili kufanikisha malengo mapya.

⏰ Msaidie kijana wako kugawanya lengo kubwa kuwa malengo madogo madogo ambayo anahitaji kuyafanikisha ili kufikia lengo kubwa.

SourceText: 📝 It is much easier to achieve a goal if you write it down! This way, you can be reminded of it as you work towards it.
text: 📝 Ni rahisi zaidi kufikia lengo ikiwa utaliandika! Kwa njia hii, unaweza kukumbushwa unapoifanyia kazi.

SourceText: Take A Pause with your Teen
text: Chukua Pumziko Na Kijana Wako

SourceText: Take a pause with your teen. This helps them deal with stress in a healthy way!
text: Chukua pumziko na kijana wako. Hii huwasaidia kukabiliana na mafadhaiko kwa njia yenye afya!

SourceText:
👂 Sit down together and close your eyes. Listen to your breath as it goes in and out. Notice how you feel. 

⭐ Take 5 more deep breaths.

👀 When you are ready, open your eyes again. Do you feel any different? 

⏸ Ask your teen what it was like to take a pause. Listen and accept whatever they say about it.
text:
👂 Keti pamoja na ufunge macho yako. Sikiliza pumzi yako inapoingia na kutoka. Angalia jinsi unavyohisi.

⭐ Vuta pumzi 5 zaidi.

👀 Ukiwa tayari, fungua macho yako tena. Je, unahisi tofauti yoyote? 

⏸ Muulize kijana wako jinsi ilivyokuwa kupumzika. Sikiliza na ukubali chochote wanachosema kuhusu hilo.

SourceText: Name That Tune
text: Taja Wimbo Huo

SourceText: Listening to music is a great way to lower your stress and have fun with your family. 💚
text: Kusikiliza muziki ni njia nzuri ya kupunguza mafadhaiko na kufurahiya na familia yako. 💚

SourceText:
📻 Gather your family members and choose one person to play, sing or hum a song.

❓ Everyone else must guess the name and artist of the song.

🎉 The first one to guess it right becomes the next person to sing or play a song. 

🔄 Keep going around until everyone has been able to play their favourite song and let the rest hear.
text:
📻 Kusanya wanafamilia wako na uchague mtu mmoja wa kucheza, kuimba au kuvuma wimbo.

❓ Kila mtu lazima akisie jina na msanii wa wimbo.

🎉 Wa kwanza kukisia sawa anakuwa mtu anayefuata kuimba au kucheza wimbo. 

🔄 Endelea kuzunguka hadi kila mtu aweze kucheza wimbo anaoupenda zaidi na uwaache wengine wasikie.

SourceText: What’s New?
text: Nini Kipya?

SourceText: Learning is fun! 🎓
text: Kujifunza ni furaha! 🎓

SourceText:
❓ Ask your teen to think of a new, fun skill you could learn together. 
- For example: keeping a ball in the air with your foot, juggling, making soup, moonwalking, whistling, saying the alphabet backwards, learning all the countries in Africa. 

🔄 Take turns trying out the new skill.  Make sure to praise each other and learn and play together!

💛 Approach learning the skill in a kind and fun way, and do not judge your teen or yourself for your ability in the skill.
text:
❓ Mwambie kijana wako afikirie ujuzi mpya, wa kufurahisha mnaoweza kujifunza pamoja. 
- Kwa mfano: kuweka mpira hewani na mguu wako, mauzauza, kupika supu, kutembea mwezi, kupiga miluzi, kusema alfabeti nyuma, kujifunza nchi zote za Afrika.

🔄 Badilishana kujaribu ujuzi mpya.  Hakikisha kusifu kila mmoja na kujifunza na kucheza pamoja!

💛 Jifunze ujuzi huo kwa njia ya fadhili na ya kufurahisha, na usijihukumu kijana wako au wewe mwenyewe kwa uwezo wako katika ujuzi huo.

SourceText: Yes, No or Maybe
text: Ndiyo, Hapana au Labda

SourceText: Are you tired of hearing your teen say yes, no, or maybe to all of your questions? Turn your chat into a game, and don’t allow one-word answers. 🎈
text: Je, umechoka kusikia kijana wako akisema ndiyo, hapana, au labda kwa maswali yako yote? Geuza gumzo lako kuwa mchezo, na usiruhusu majibu ya neno moja. 🎈

SourceText:
⭐ Take turns asking each other questions. The only rule is that you cannot use one-word responses, such as Yes, No, Maybe, Fine, and Okay.
⚽ You can ask about things your teen likes or what they did today. For example, how was your day? What are you excited for? Is there anything worrying you?
🔄 It is important to let your teen ask a question as well. Trust is built when your teen can see that you are also sharing your life with them, and not only trying to learn about their life.
text:
⭐ Kuulizana maswali kwa zamu. Kanuni pekee ni kwamba huwezi kutumia majibu ya neno moja, kama vile Ndiyo, Hapana, Labda, Sawa, na Sawa.
⚽ Unaweza kuuliza kuhusu mambo ambayo kijana wako anapenda au alichofanya leo. Kwa mfano, siku yako ilikuwaje? Je, unachangamkia nini? Je, kuna jambo lolote linalokusumbua?
🔄 Ni muhimu kumruhusu kijana wako aulize swali pia. Uaminifu hujengwa wakati kijana wako anaweza kuona kwamba pia unashiriki maisha yako naye, na sio tu kujaribu kujifunza kuhusu maisha yao.

SourceText: Secret Handshake
text: Kushikana Mikono kwa siri

SourceText:
Let’s make a special, fun, and unique handshake that only you and your child share 👋  

This isn’t just about having fun - it helps build your child’s confidence and teamwork skills while creating a special tradition you both can enjoy. ✅
text:
Hebu tufanye kupeana mikono maalum, ya kufurahisha na ya kipekee ambayo wewe na mtoto wako pekee mnashiriki 👋

Hii siyo tu kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha — pia inasaidia kumjengea mtoto wako kujiamini na kujifunza kushirikiana, huku mkiunda desturi maalum ya kufurahia pamoja. ✅

SourceText:
🔶 First, sit down together and talk about the kind of handshake you want. Should it be quick and silly, or cool and complicated? It’s totally up to you! 

🎵 You can start by choosing a few simple moves like clapping patterns, high fives, fist bumps, or snapping fingers.

🔄 Next, practice adding different steps. Maybe a spin, a shoulder tap, or even a fun dance move. The more creative and playful, the better!

💛 Once you’ve mastered your moves, make your secret handshake a part of your routine! Use it as a fun greeting after school, or anytime you want to feel that special connection.
text:
🔶 Kwanza, keti pamoja na mzungumze kuhusu aina ya kupeana mikono unayotaka. Je! inapaswa kuwa ya haraka na ya kijinga, au ya baridi na ngumu? Ni juu yako kabisa! 

🎵 Unaweza kuanza kwa kuchagua miondoko michache rahisi kama vile mifumo ya kupiga makofi, mikunjo ya juu, ngumi, au kupiga vidole.

🔄 Kisha, fanya mazoezi ya kuongeza hatua tofauti. Labda zunguka, bomba la bega, au hata hoja ya ngoma ya kufurahisha. Ubunifu zaidi na wa kucheza, ni bora zaidi!

💛 Mara tu unapofahamu hatua zako, fanya kupeana mkono kwa siri iwe sehemu ya utaratibu wako! Itumie kama salamu ya kufurahisha baada ya shule, au wakati wowote unapotaka kuhisi muunganisho huo maalum.

SourceText: Bao
text: Bao

SourceText: Playing Bao can be a fun way to spend time with your teen. They will be excited to play a game with you and not only do chores.
text: Kucheza Bao inaweza kuwa njia ya kufurahisha ya kutumia muda pamoja na kijana wako. Watakuwa na hamasa kucheza mchezo pamoja na wewe na sio tu kufanya kazi.

SourceText:
🪣 Draw a board in the sand — 2 rows of 8 small holes and 2 big holes at the ends.
🌱 Find 32 small seeds or stones.

1️⃣ Put 2 seeds in each small hole. Leave the big holes empty.
2️⃣ Choose who starts. Take the 2 seeds from one hole and drop them one by one into the next holes going around. Then it’s the other person’s turn.
3️⃣ Keep playing until no one can move. The person with more seeds in their big hole wins! 🏆
text:
🪣 Chora ubao kwenye mchanga — mistari 2 yenye mashimo madogo 8 kila moja na mashimo 2 makubwa kwenye ncha zake.
🌱 Tafuta mbegu ndogo au mawe madogo 32.

1️⃣ Weka mbegu 2 katika kila shimo dogo. Acha mashimo makubwa yakiwa matupu.
2️⃣ Chagueni ni nani ataanza. Chukua mbegu 2 kutoka shimo moja na ziweke moja moja kwenye mashimo yanayofuata kwa kuzunguka. Kisha ni zamu ya mtu mwingine.
3️⃣ Endeleeni kucheza hadi hakuna anayeweza kufanya mzunguko tena. Mtu mwenye mbegu nyingi zaidi kwenye shimo lake kubwa ndiye mshindi! 🏆

text:
